author: Ifmyante
text:
So, I got asked in a pm yesterday could I clarify my position on
awaiting a full retrace. The person in question is tired of missing
opportunities.

Well, I can't! I miss opportunities too by waiting for the best possible price.

My last non-trade is a fine example of this. I was clever enough to take
 my profits on the pause at the very top, but I hoped for the news that
day to whipsaw price back up to my limit order. It didn't and I was left
 on the empty platform after the train had left.

It's an occupational hazard, I'm afraid

Please don't anybody tell me how many pips it's traveled. I've refused to check!

author: GGJJ
text:
Hi Edge, V and IF,

Here is my thought on this topic.

Regarding RTM promoting, one of the ideas which will attract more people
 I think is to show them where to put the entry/SL before price reaches
there. People would be able to make some real money without any analysis
 or thinking, just copying IF or (masters)'s trades. MPL trades would be
 the best candidate. Tiny SL, little risk.

I said SOME money, no need to show trade opportunities over again and
again. Just enough trades to make people believe RTM can help them make
some real money.

I clearly knew this is very challenging for IF or masters or the people
who predicts the price(maybe I am wrong, it is easy for IF or masters ).
 What if the prediction is wrong? I do not think being wrong sometimes
is not a big deal (as we all know). The idea is to make profits overall
(10-20 trades within a few months let’s say). One of the keys we show
here is to be honest to people. (Do not get me wrong, we are not
honest now). The aim is to make people believe.

If people made some real money, they would believe RTM is the way for them. If they want to learn more, they have to join it.

We have already posted trades RTM members took weekly. This method is
less effective and cannot convince people. Why? 1. Anyone can mark such
 a chart for the past. 2. Even people believe that trade is genuine,
that could be one of them in 100 trades for example.

Another idea is to predict price again, but have a voting system to show
 how many RTM members support this prediction. I believe more people
support a prediction, less likely the trade would go wrong. There are a
lot to play in this area. Basically getting people involved.

I remember there was an idea before called “daily opportunities”. Many
people would be interested in this section if we have one in forum.

I am not encouraging laziness, people do not do their own study/hardwork
 and just copy other people’s ideas. There are a lot of details which
need to be thought about how to make it working.

I am sure there are other considerations I have missed. Any comments are welcome! Brainstorming!

author: Frosty
text:
Pardon me for intruding on this subject matter.

I do feel the same way with bro IF regarding the toxicity level in FF.

If I may comment, personal opinion only, a healthy mind and spirit is the source of good health,

so leaving behind and ignoring toxic/negative people with death and
decay aura around them is, imho, the best way to go forward in life.

I've met countless numbers of people I call "infectors" in business and in life to understand this for a fact.

These are people that always act as the victim and blame everything/everyone except themselves for their problems.

And, usually, according to my observations, they easily attract like-minded people to enforce their dumb belief and negativity.

So they usually have the horde by their side to further give them a sense of "power".

Somehow they also love it when we add fuel to the fire by getting angry or irritated at their comments and arguments.

In the beginning, I was in "enforce justice" mode, correcting or trying
to correct every of their wrong ways, talks, and actions.

Got into too many unimportant arguments, which seems to be important at that time.

I would get physically weak and get ill often. Like a cold or cough
almost every month. Stomach problems was a regular experience as well.

Then I tried a new thing of doing things, accept people for what they are, even of they are what we consider "trash".

Its hard to explain but the feeling is like: "OK, so there is this
person/these groups of people. Danger. Avoid at all cost. Done"

No emotional charge at all when I start to accept that they are only a
small part of the universe and a small speed bump along the way.

Keeping all other things constant like food intake, workload, etc. (this
 was before I went on a diet), I improved my health overall.

The physical illness is not a common occurrence anymore.

So, corny ramble aside, I personally respect what bro IF, Edge, and Gslao have done and will do in the future.

However, please please brothers, take care of your mental health by
ignoring/avoiding contact with toxic people, because I fear it would
take a toll on your physical well-being if you keep engaging with them.

I always believed that a healthy body starts with a healthy mind.

I hope this doesn't offend anyone. If I did, I sincerely apologize.

I think the only thing I'm good at in RTM is rambling nonsense

I truly wish bro IF, Edge, and Gslao all the best with RTMA.
